name: The Acolyte
description: A young man in pale robes in the temple anteroom who tries to read Nissa's mind and announces the Trial of Knowledge; this page does not name him.

description_citations.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: A young man in the anteroom tries to probe Nissa's mind, fails, and admits she is not from here.
timeline.quote: You . . . you . . . are not from here,

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The young man tells her she may attempt the Trial of Knowledge; Nissa panics, flings him against the wall, and runs into the blue light.
timeline.quote: she flung him against the stone walls.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.
